title: v2.1.128 Release
description: Latest Claude Code release with random session colors, MCP tool counts, plugin zip support, console channels for API key auth, model picker cleanup, OTEL isolation improvements, and numerous bug fixes.

title: PR Review, Build Plan in Parallel, and Split PRs
description: New PR review experience with inline review threads, commits tab, and changes tab. Build in parallel from plans using async subagents. Split changes into PRs with quick action. Pin skills as quick actions. Context usage breakdown.

title: Model Controls, Spend Management, and Usage Analytics
description: Enterprise admins get model access controls with granular allow/blocklists, soft spend limits with intelligent alerts, updated usage analytics tab filtering, and team marketplace updates.

title: Cursor Security Review Beta
description: Cursor Security Review now in beta on Teams and Enterprise plans with Security Reviewer (checks PRs for vulnerabilities) and Vulnerability Scanner (scheduled scans of codebase). Customizable security agents.

title: Aider v0.56.0
description: Enables prompt caching for Sonnet via OpenRouter, 8k output tokens for Sonnet via VertexAI and DeepSeek V2.5, new /report command for GitHub Issues, --chat-language switch, and numerous bug fixes.

title: v2.1.126 Release - Project Purge & Enhanced Features
description: Added project purge command, broader skip-permissions, pasteable OAuth codes, skill activation telemetry, gateway model picker, Windows PowerShell detection, and security fixes.
